why_ai: Satellites can't be touched after launch, but fleet-health, interference and collision calls are high-stakes and demand for satellite connectivity grows with AI and remote work.
why_clarity: Availability, throughput and imagery delivery are measured objectively, but early anomaly reads and interference diagnosis remain tacit and are graded late.
why_digital: Work starts from telemetry, spectrum and imagery of physical assets and ends as connectivity or data delivered remotely to business buyers worldwide.

why_ai: Fill and replacement decisions are consequential and slow to resolve, and long customer relationships matter, but capacity planning itself is modelling work.
why_clarity: Fill and backlog are measurable, but whether a replacement or extension was right is known years later.
why_digital: Contracts, telemetry-derived life estimates and demand data on screens; buyers are telcos, broadcasters and governments dealing account by account.

why_ai: Retention rests on slot incumbency and relationships, but the segment is shrinking as IP delivery substitutes for satellite.
why_clarity: Renewal outcomes are clear and recur by contract, though attrition drivers are judged by account teams.
why_digital: Channel lineups, headend registries and contracts on screens; renewals negotiated with broadcasters and platforms.

why_ai: Multi-orbit network design and pricing are modelling tasks open to automation; SLA judgement keeps some human role.
why_clarity: Link budgets and availability are computed by codified methods, though bid outcomes depend on competitors.
why_digital: Site lists, link budgets and network data in; managed service delivered remotely, sold through enterprise and carrier sales cycles.

why_ai: Terminals on aircraft and ships need physical installation and repair, and fleet relationships are sticky; demand for in-flight and at-sea connectivity is growing.
why_clarity: Per-flight and per-voyage performance is measured continuously, though fault attribution across the chain is disputed.
why_digital: Telemetry from moving platforms in, connectivity out; sold to airlines and ship managers in multi-year fleet deals.

why_ai: Filings carry the administration's and licensee's accountability and coordination is adversarial negotiation over years, but deadline tracking and screening automate well.
why_clarity: Rules and deadlines are codified, but whether a coordination position paid off is known only years later.
why_digital: Filings, databases and correspondence in, filings and agreements out, all electronic and handled with remote counterparts worldwide.

why_ai: Classification and case handling automate, but the fix usually needs a person to find and re-point a dish, and deliberate cases are adversarial.
why_clarity: A case is resolved or not within hours, but identifying the source is still done by experienced engineers by feel.
why_digital: Spectrum traces and network data in; the result is a restored carrier, often after a physical fix in the field.

why_ai: Shared operations and licensing support are service work open to automation, with anomaly recovery and regulatory judgement still consequential.
why_clarity: Contact success and recovery time are measurable, but each startup's spacecraft behaves differently.
why_digital: Telemetry, schedules and filings in; operations and licences delivered remotely to startups anywhere.

why_ai: Service depends on satellites, spectrum rights and carrier partnerships rather than personal trust, and demand from users beyond coverage is growing.
why_clarity: Message delivery succeeds or fails per attempt across millions of attempts, though coverage claims are still loosely defined.
why_digital: Constellation and delivery data in, connectivity to phones out, sold through carrier partners rather than directly.

why_ai: Screening and triage are prime automation targets; a human still signs off manoeuvres for liability reasons.
why_clarity: Warnings are structured and screening methods codified, but whether an avoided collision would have happened is only known from later tracking.
why_digital: Orbit data in, decisions and manoeuvre plans out, all on screens and bought as remote services.

why_ai: Order handling, quality checks and re-tasking are mechanical and largely automatable.
why_clarity: A delivered scene meets the customer's criteria or not, checkable immediately across thousands of orders.
why_digital: Imagery of physical places in, digital products out, ordered and delivered online.

why_ai: Vessel-behaviour scoring is model work facing AI-native competition, though sanctions investigations stay adversarial.
why_clarity: Risk scores recur for every vessel, but whether a flagged vessel was evading sanctions is confirmed late, if ever.
why_digital: Satellite signals in, risk scores and reports out, sold online to global buyers.

why_ai: Site measurement from imagery is a direct automation target and the imagery can be bought by anyone.
why_clarity: Each reading is checked against official releases within days.
why_digital: Imagery in, numeric estimates out, sold online to traders worldwide.

why_ai: Filings are made under an administration's authority and coordination is negotiated, which keeps experienced engineers in demand.
why_clarity: The Radio Regulations codify the analyses and deadlines, but each study is shaped by its orbit and band, and a weak comment or missed window surfaces only years later in coordination.
why_digital: Filing data and databases in, filings and studies out, delivered electronically to operators worldwide.

why_ai: Licensed attorneys must sign and argue filings, clients buy specific practitioners, and proceedings are adversarial.
why_clarity: Filings have defined forms but outcomes depend on contested FCC judgement and arrive months later.
why_digital: Documents in and out on screens; clients still choose counsel by reputation and relationships.

why_ai: Sensor networks are physical but run remotely, and screening is automated software competing with free government services.
why_clarity: Screening is codified and repeats thousands of times, but collision outcomes are known only from later tracking.
why_digital: Observations in, catalogues and warnings out, sold as data services to operators and governments.

why_ai: Forecasts built mostly on public data face direct AI substitution, though the firms' relationships and judgement carry some weight.
why_clarity: Reports recur annually, but forecast accuracy is rarely checked and is known years later.
why_digital: Public data and interviews in, reports out, sold online to a global client base.

why_ai: Detection is automating, but attribution and verification reports used in regulation keep expert sign-off, and regulatory demand is rising.
why_clarity: Detections and quantification follow published methods, with ground truth from controlled releases and operator follow-up.
why_digital: Spectral imagery in, emissions estimates and reports out, all digital and sold globally.

why_ai: Footprint extraction automates, but event-time judgement on damage under uncertainty stays valuable and demand rises with losses.
why_clarity: Footprints are checked against claims within weeks, with codified extraction methods.
why_digital: Radar and optical imagery in, footprints and reports out, delivered online to insurers worldwide.

why_ai: Anomaly investigations carry contractual and insurance liability, operators depend on the builder's engineers, and each anomaly is novel.
why_clarity: Anomalies are well documented, but each investigation differs and root causes are confirmed slowly.
why_digital: Telemetry in, investigations and alerts out, delivered remotely under long support contracts.

why_ai: Underwriters carry the risk decision personally within their authority, relationships drive placements, and each risk is large and novel.
why_clarity: Pricing follows practice rather than a codified method, and losses arrive years after the policy.
why_digital: Engineering disclosures in, policies out; placements still run through relationships in a few markets.

why_ai: Statutory and treaty authority to license, examine and decide keeps the work with accountable officials.
why_clarity: Procedures are codified, but the effect of a licensing decision unfolds over years.
why_digital: Filings in, decisions and publications out on screens; the buyers are governments and member states.

why_ai: Equipment and monitoring services are increasingly software-defined and automatable.
why_clarity: Monitoring and geolocation follow codified methods with fast checks.
why_digital: Equipment and signals in, software and services out, sold to operators worldwide.

why_ai: Intelligence analysis is accountable, adversarial and consequential, and government demand is growing.
why_clarity: Tradecraft is codified but the value of an assessment is known late.
why_digital: Imagery and signals on screens; buying requires clearances, presence and federal procurement.

why_ai: Licensing is a statutory function held by accountable officials; screening is automated software.
why_clarity: Licence reviews follow codified rules; screening outcomes are checked against tracking.
why_digital: Applications and orbit data in, licences and screening out; the buyer is the federal budget.

why_ai: Advocacy depends on relationships and judgement in policy processes.
why_clarity: Advocacy success is hard to define and known years later.
why_digital: Policy filings and reports, mostly digital, with member relationships built in person.

why_ai: Deal judgement is novel and consequential, with relationships mattering in each acquisition.
why_clarity: Each deal is one-off and its success is known years after closing.
why_digital: Financial and network data on screens; the platforms run physical service businesses.

why_ai: Search, ordering and delivery are software that operators can replicate or bypass.
why_clarity: Orders are fulfilled or not, instantly and objectively.
why_digital: Fully digital marketplaces selling digital products online.

why_ai: Compiling public launch and anomaly records is automatable.
why_clarity: Records are defined and checkable, though anomaly causes are confirmed slowly.
why_digital: Public and reported data in, a database out, sold online.
